name: Ops Assistant Landing
summary: Full marketing landing for an operations assistant, rebuilt section by section from a reference site: scroll-pill header, sky hero with a phone that scrolls through a chat, inline-image headline, phone feature tabs, integration grid, two phone split sections, chat testimonials, setup steps, FAQ, night CTA with footer, and a torn-paper manifesto dialog.
useWhen: Starting a product landing page for an assistant or B2B tool with a phone-first story
Needing the whole page with scroll motion, header pill and a manifesto dialog already wired
avoidWhen: Only one or two sections are needed; use the marketing components directly
A dashboard or app shell rather than a marketing page
source: moonin.ai (layout, spacing and motion reference); copy, brand and imagery replaced with neutral placeholders
